comparisons.name: about-this-mac-light
comparisons.description: The About This Mac window at its frame, Aqua. The Catalina badge is Apple's artwork: a ring stands in for it and the mask covers it. The serial number, which only the dark capture shows, and the four corners, where the capture shows the desktop picture, are masked too.

comparisons.name: about-this-mac-light-layout
comparisons.description: As about-this-mac-light with the tab titles, the title, the version line, the details, the button titles and the legal text masked as well, to score the frame, the title bar, the tab control and the buttons' drawing alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: about-this-mac-dark
comparisons.description: The About This Mac window at its frame, Dark Aqua. The Catalina badge is Apple's artwork: a ring stands in for it and the mask covers it. The serial number, which only the dark capture shows, and the four corners, where the capture shows the desktop picture, are masked too.

comparisons.name: about-this-mac-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As about-this-mac-dark with the tab titles, the title, the version line, the details, the button titles and the legal text masked as well, to score the frame, the title bar, the tab control and the buttons' drawing alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: tab-click-light
comparisons.description: Another tab selected with a click, Aqua. No screenshot shows it: the fills are those measured on the capture's selected and unselected tabs.

pixels.note: Displays, now selected: the selected fill 2 pt below its top, measured on the capture's Overview tab (column x=1420, y=410); that the clicked tab takes it is inferred
Overview, no longer selected: the unselected fill 2 pt below its top, measured on the capture's Displays tab (column x=1560, y=410)

comparisons.name: tab-click-dark
comparisons.description: Another tab selected with a click, Dark Aqua. No screenshot shows it: the fills are those measured on the capture's selected and unselected tabs.

pixels.note: Displays, now selected: the selected fill 2 pt below its top, measured on the capture's Overview tab (column x=1420, y=410); that the clicked tab takes it is inferred

Overview, no longer selected: the unselected fill 2 pt below its top, white at 23.3% over the title bar material at this height (#3c3d3e); computed from the tokens. The capture's bar is lighter by three levels, tinted by the desktop picture

comparisons.name: tab-arrow-key-light
comparisons.description: The right arrow key pressed with the focus on the first tab, Aqua: the next tab is selected and has the focus ring. No screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: Displays, selected by the arrow key: the measured selected fill (inferred behaviour: AppKit's segmented control selects as the focus moves)
focus ring, the 3 pt above the tab: --mac-focus-ring-color (blue at 50%) over the title bar's measured #e0e0e0 at this height; computed, the ring on a tab is inferred
title bar just above the ring, measured at y=396 of the capture: the ring ends 3 pt beyond the tab

comparisons.name: tab-arrow-key-dark
comparisons.description: The right arrow key pressed with the focus on the first tab, Dark Aqua: the next tab is selected and has the focus ring. No screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: Displays, selected by the arrow key: the measured selected fill (inferred behaviour: AppKit's segmented control selects as the focus moves)
focus ring, the 3 pt above the tab: --mac-focus-ring-color (blue at 50%) over the title bar material at this height (#3d3e3f); computed, the ring on a tab is inferred
title bar just above the ring, the material's gradient (#404142 to #343435 over 38 pt) at this height: the ring ends 3 pt beyond the tab

comparisons.name: inactive-light
comparisons.description: The tab control in an inactive window, Aqua. No screenshot shows it: the selection at half strength over the flat inactive title bar is an inference.

pixels.note: selected tab: the measured selected fill #6f6f6f at 50% over the inactive title bar #f6f6f6; computed, inferred
unselected tab: the fill is unchanged; inferred

comparisons.name: inactive-dark
comparisons.description: The tab control in an inactive window, Dark Aqua. No screenshot shows it: the selection at half strength over the flat inactive title bar is an inference.

pixels.note: selected tab: the measured selected fill #cacacc at 50% over the inactive title bar #2d2d2d; computed, inferred
unselected tab: the fill's white at 23.4% over the inactive title bar #2d2d2d; computed, inferred
